steps.what: Open the commercial brief and stock
Plan commercial displays for the customers
Note which appeal the plan keeps

tasks.design: The campaign brief and current stock are opened from {DOCS} and {ERP}. Planning the commercial display stays with the displayer. The brief does not choose the appeal.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans started from a mailed brief and a walk of the stock.
tasks.enabler_now: The brief and the stock list can be opened together.
tasks.still_hard: What will entice a customer is still a plan made in the space.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer sees the sightline the brief does not.
tasks.altitude: The week still starts in the space. The brief is only already open.

evidence.claim: Opening a brief is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a commercial brief arrives and ends when the displayer notes the plan.
A brief has an id, a date, and a product list, produced by the store manager. A product not on the list is not added to the plan by the screen.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether briefs name the products that may be shown.
research_questions: Who accepts a display plan before it is built?

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when the brief is a mail thread. Planning stays in person. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange merchandise from the prepared sketches

steps.what: Arrange merchandise as the prepared sketches show
Note accessories that would not fit

tasks.design: Prepared sketches are opened from {DOCS}. Arranging properties, furniture, merchandise, backdrops, and accessories stays in the hands, as the sketch shows.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sketches were printed and then lost on the floor.
tasks.enabler_now: The sketch for that display can be opened on the floor.
tasks.still_hard: Arranging the pieces is physical work.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer feels when a piece will not stand as drawn.
tasks.altitude: The sketch is at hand. The arranging does not move.

evidence.claim: A stored sketch is a record. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a sketch is issued and ends when the merchandise is arranged.
A sketch has a display id and an image, produced by the person who drew it. A missing piece is noted, not substituted by the screen.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether every display has a sketch before it is arranged.
research_questions: Who may change a sketch after arranging has started?

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when sketches are paper only. Arranging stays in the hands. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Rotate window displays for a promotion

steps.what: List inventory changes for the promotion
Rotate window displays and interior signage
Note signage the change did not cover

tasks.design: Inventory changes and the promotion date are listed from {ERP} and {CALENDAR}. Rotating window displays, interior areas, and signage stays physical.
tasks.previous_blocker: Promotion changes arrived by message after the window was already dressed.
tasks.enabler_now: A change row can name the item and the date.
tasks.still_hard: Taking the display apart and dressing it again is physical.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer sees stock that is not actually on the shelf.
tasks.altitude: The change list is current. The rotation stays in the window.

reach.task: Confirm the window matches the promotion

evidence.claim: A promotion list is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when inventory or a promotion changes and ends when the window and the interior signage are rotated.
A change has an item id, a date, and a promotion id, produced by the stock record. An item with no row is not treated as part of the promotion.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether promotion dates and stock changes share one list.
research_questions: How often are windows required to change?

already_counted.description: The hands-on time is already in the main step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when changes are messages. The rotation stays physical. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Place price signs that match the file

steps.what: Show prices for the descriptive signs
Check prices against the merchandise file
Place prices and descriptive signs on fixtures

tasks.design: Prices are shown from {ERP}. The displayer checks them, then places descriptive signs on backdrops, fixtures, merchandise, or the floor. A price that is not in the file is not placed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prices were copied from a sheet that was already out of date.
tasks.enabler_now: A price row can be shown next to the sign text.
tasks.still_hard: Placing the sign, and spotting a price that looks wrong in the space, stays physical.
tasks.human_edge: The displayer sees a fixture the file does not describe.
tasks.altitude: The price is looked up. Placing the sign stays in the hands.

evidence.claim: Showing a stored price is configuration. The source pack says a locked template can be filled from a table and a person checks it, and that the final selection of a design stays manual.

The source pack says a generated image must be marked, and that naming faces in an archive is biometric data needing explicit consent. This work does not generate the display and does not name faces. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when signs are due and ends when the signs are placed.
A price row has an item id, an amount, and a short description, produced by the price file. A row with no amount is shown as missing and is not placed.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the displayer's effort.
A missing sketch, price, or plan is not invented. The displayer does that part by hand.
The incremental hour updates the list when the source row changes.
unknowns: Whether every signed item has a current price row.
research_questions: Who may change a price the displayer is about to place?

already_counted.description: Placing signs is already in the placing step.

incremental.description: Pull a sign when its price row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when prices are not in the file. Placing stays physical. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Planning, arranging, rotating, and placing signs stay in the hands. A brief, a sketch, a promotion list, and a price can be opened. They do not build the display.
reach: The store manager sees the plan, not a generated picture.
A price that is not in the file is not placed.
skills_to_grow: Do not invent a product the brief does not name.
Do not treat a sketch as already arranged.
role.ambitious_version: A promotion change is visible the same day, and the window is still dressed by a person.
